content: The ACC 2011 schedule outlines the coordination of interviews and presentations during the conference, which takes place from Saturday, April 2nd, to Tuesday, April 5th, 2011. Filming will occur during this period. Dr. Gibson is available for interviews during the times listed in black, while the times in red indicate his unavailability. Presenters are encouraged to proceed with their topics and slide presentations as scheduled. Friday, April 1, 2011 1:30 PM: Open time slot. Saturday, April 2, 2011 5:00 PM: Open time slot. Sunday, April 3, 2011 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Dr. Yukihiro Koretsune will discuss the RE-LY Japanese data trial. 9:30 AM 10:30 AM: Open time slots. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Dr. Martin Leon will present findings from the RESOLUTE US Study on one-year clinical outcomes. The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 12:15 PM. 1:00 PM 1:30 PM: Open time slot. 1:30 PM 2:00 PM: Dr. John Bisognano will discuss the Rheos Pivotal Trial on baroreflex activation therapy for resistant hypertension. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, April 5th, at 12:15 PM. 2:00 PM 2:30 PM: Dr. Carlo Briguori will present the REMEDIAL II trial on renal insufficiency following contrast media administration. The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 12:15 PM. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Open time slot. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Dr. Julinda Mehilli will discuss long-term outcomes of drug-eluting stents versus bare-metal stents in saphenous vein graft lesions (ISAR-CABG trial). The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 12:15 PM. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Dr. Stephen E. Fremes will present findings from the RAPS study on radial artery and saphenous vein patency after coronary artery bypass surgery. The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 9:30 AM. 4:00 PM 4:30 PM: Dr. Morten Schou will discuss NT-proBNP stratified follow-up in heart failure clinics (Danish Heart Failure Clinics Network trial). The embargo lifts on Tuesday, April 5th, at 12:15 PM. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Dr. Goto will discuss the RE-LY Japanese data trial. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Dr. Sunil Rao will present on LBCTs in the radial world. Monday, April 4, 2011 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Dr. Sanjit Jolly will discuss the RIVAL trial comparing radial versus femoral access for coronary angiography in acute coronary syndromes. The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 12:15 PM. 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Dr. Gilles Montalescot will provide a French ACC wrap-up. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Dr. John D. Puskas will discuss reduced anticoagulation for mechanical heart valves. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, April 5th, at 12:15 PM. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Open time slot. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Open time slot. 2:30 PM 3:00 PM: Dr. Basil Lewis will provide an Israeli ACC wrap-up. 3:00 PM 3:30 PM: Dr. Robert Bonow will discuss myocardial viability and outcomes in coronary artery disease patients undergoing medical therapy with or without surgical revascularization (STICH trial). The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 9:30 AM. 3:30 PM 4:00 PM: Dr. Gregg Stone will present findings from the PLATINUM trial on a novel platinum chromium everolimus-eluting coronary stent. The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 12:15 PM. 4:00 PM 4:30 PM: Dr. A. Verheugt will provide a Dutch ACC wrap-up. 4:30 PM 5:00 PM: Dr. Craig Smith will discuss the PARTNER trial comparing transcatheter aortic valve implantation versus surgical aortic valve replacement in high-risk aortic stenosis patients. The embargo lifts on Sunday, April 3rd, at 10:00 AM. 5:00 PM 5:30 PM: Dr. Eric Velazquez will discuss medical therapy with or without coronary artery bypass graft surgery in ischemic cardiomyopathy patients (STICH trial). The embargo lifts on Monday, April 4th, at 9:30 AM. 5:30 PM 6:00 PM: Dr. A. Michael Lincoff will present findings from the PROTECTION-AMI trial on selective inhibition of delta protein kinase C to reduce infarct size after primary PCI for acute myocardial infarction. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, April 5th, at 9:30 AM. Tuesday, April 5, 2011 8:00 AM 8:30 AM: Dr. Paul Armstrong will provide a Canadian ACC wrap-up. 9:00 AM 9:30 AM: Dr. Renato Lopes will provide an ACC wrap-up in Portuguese. 9:30 AM 10:00 AM: Dr. Lars Wallentin will provide a Scandinavian ACC wrap-up. 10:00 AM 10:30 AM: Dr. Sergio Leonardi and Dr. Giuseppe Patti will provide an ACC wrap-up in Italian. 10:15 AM 10:30 AM: Dr. Gibson and Dr. Harrington will provide an ACC wrap-up. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Dr. Harvey White will provide a Pacific Rim ACC wrap-up. 11:00 AM 11:30 AM: Dr. Hisao Ogawa will discuss the OSCAR study comparing high-dose ARB monotherapy versus combination therapy with ARB and calcium channel blockers in elderly Japanese hypertensive patients.
